evidence.title: A lake pilgrimage and a quiet car ride to the beach: last hours of sisters who took own lives in Brighton

occurrences.checkable_against: Train ticketing data, CCTV and police investigation records
occurrences.quote_span: On the evening on 12 May, the inquest heard, the three women caught a train to Brighton, arriving at 10.20pm, and then took a car to the beachfront near the marina.
occurrences.speaker: Brighton inquest
occurrences.subject: Deaths of Jane Adetoro, Christina Walters and Rebecca Walters

occurrences.checkable_against: Jane Adetoro's financial records
occurrences.quote_span: Jane, who was also an accountant, had paid off a loan in full on 11 May.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Deaths of Jane Adetoro, Christina Walters and Rebecca Walters

occurrences.checkable_against: Sussex police CCTV review records
occurrences.quote_span: Sussex police reviewed hundreds of hours of CCTV to establish that for at least four hours the women paced the seafront in the darkness.
occurrences.speaker: Sussex police
occurrences.subject: Deaths of Jane Adetoro, Christina Walters and Rebecca Walters

occurrences.checkable_against: Natalie Walters-Daniel's quoted statement to the newspaper
occurrences.quote_span: The tragedy of the sisters’ deaths “wasn’t a story that started in May”, their cousin Natalie Walters-Daniel told the newspaper last month. “It was a story that started long before.”
occurrences.speaker: Natalie Walters-Daniel
occurrences.subject: Deaths of Jane Adetoro, Christina Walters and Rebecca Walters

occurrences.checkable_against: Uber driver's police statement
occurrences.quote_span: The Uber driver was struck by the lack of conversation between them, he later told police.
occurrences.speaker: Uber driver
occurrences.subject: Deaths of Jane Adetoro, Christina Walters and Rebecca Walters

occurrences.checkable_against: Brighton coroner and RNLI recovery records for 13 May 2026
occurrences.quote_span: Early in the morning of 13 May, the sisters’ bodies were recovered from the sea in Brighton, hours after a taxi had dropped the three women at the beachfront.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Deaths of Jane Adetoro, Christina Walters and Rebecca Walters

occurrences.checkable_against: RNLI, police and coroner records
occurrences.quote_span: Jane was brought to shore by an RNLI crew and declared dead at the scene. Christina’s body was also located by the lifeboat crew. Rebecca’s body was recovered from Brighton beach where it appeared to have been washed to shore.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Deaths of Jane Adetoro, Christina Walters and Rebecca Walters

occurrences.checkable_against: Christina Walters's internet search history and employment and education records
occurrences.quote_span: The inquest heard that Christina, who had recently graduated from Brunel University of London and worked as an accountant, had experienced anxiety and depression since her mother’s death and made “extensive searches” about suicide in the days before her own death.
occurrences.speaker: Brighton inquest
occurrences.subject: Deaths of Jane Adetoro, Christina Walters and Rebecca Walters

occurrences.checkable_against: Emergency services call logs
occurrences.quote_span: Emergency services were called after a cyclist reported seeing a body on the beach shortly before 5.45am.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Deaths of Jane Adetoro, Christina Walters and Rebecca Walters

occurrences.checkable_against: UK legal name-change and identity records
occurrences.quote_span: The two younger sisters had changed their names to their mother’s maiden name after her death.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Deaths of Jane Adetoro, Christina Walters and Rebecca Walters

occurrences.checkable_against: Rebecca Walters's employment records
occurrences.quote_span: Rebecca, “the baby” to relatives, worked in HR.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Deaths of Jane Adetoro, Christina Walters and Rebecca Walters

occurrences.checkable_against: Met Office weather records and Brighton inquest transcript
occurrences.quote_span: It was a windy night and the sea was particularly rough, Cullimore told the inquest.
occurrences.speaker: DCI Mark Cullimore
occurrences.subject: Deaths of Jane Adetoro, Christina Walters and Rebecca Walters

occurrences.checkable_against: Sussex police investigation and taxi records
occurrences.quote_span: DCI Mark Cullimore, of Sussex police, told the inquest there was no CCTV to show what the three sisters did in the time they were in Birmingham, but less than two hours after arriving, at 1.28am on 12 May, they were picked up by taxi and driven back to their London flat.
occurrences.speaker: DCI Mark Cullimore
occurrences.subject: Deaths of Jane Adetoro, Christina Walters and Rebecca Walters

occurrences.checkable_against: Uber trip records and police investigation records
occurrences.quote_span: On the night of 11 May, the sisters travelled by Uber from their home in Greenford, west London, to Birmingham, where they were dropped off at 11.36pm in Linton Walk, in the north of the city.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Deaths of Jane Adetoro, Christina Walters and Rebecca Walters

occurrences.checkable_against: Brighton inquest transcript and Sussex police investigation file
occurrences.quote_span: Cullimore told the inquest he had “remained open-minded throughout and always considered whether there was third-party involvement” but he was now satisfied there had not been.
occurrences.speaker: DCI Mark Cullimore
occurrences.subject: Deaths of Jane Adetoro, Christina Walters and Rebecca Walters

occurrences.checkable_against: Jane Adetoro's financial records
occurrences.quote_span: Jane, who was also an accountant, had paid off a loan in full on 11 May.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Deaths of Jane Adetoro, Christina Walters and Rebecca Walters

occurrences.checkable_against: Joseph Jacobson's statement to the Brighton inquest
occurrences.quote_span: Jane, Christina and Rebecca, is a heartbreak beyond anything I could ever have imagined.”
occurrences.speaker: Joseph Jacobson
occurrences.subject: Deaths of Jane Adetoro, Christina Walters and Rebecca Walters

occurrences.checkable_against: Toxicology reports, postmortem records and Sussex police investigation file
occurrences.quote_span: There was no evidence that any of the sisters had used drugs or alcohol, and no indication of any violence.
occurrences.speaker: DCI Mark Cullimore
occurrences.subject: Deaths of Jane Adetoro, Christina Walters and Rebecca Walters

occurrences.checkable_against: Sussex police CCTV footage
occurrences.quote_span: They were picked up periodically in snatches of footage, last being seen at 2.42am.
occurrences.speaker: Sussex police
occurrences.subject: Deaths of Jane Adetoro, Christina Walters and Rebecca Walters

occurrences.checkable_against: Coroner and family records
occurrences.quote_span: None of the women had been able to swim.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Deaths of Jane Adetoro, Christina Walters and Rebecca Walters
